title: had Claude create Bloom and CRT shaders based on a video that goes into detail about how Animal Well achieves its distinctive look
author: BenMakesGames
selftext:
after watching this video that dissects some of the shaders Animal Well uses - [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HtaleVLNws8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HtaleVLNws8) \- I thought I'd have a go at creating some similar shaders for my game... well: or describing what I wanted to Claude, and having *it* have a go :P

it took a bit of back and forth, but we got there.

I've posted the full code of the two shaders as gists, here: [https://gist.github.com/BenMakesGames/3d00a6072c6ed1f4118d99217891429b](https://gist.github.com/BenMakesGames/3d00a6072c6ed1f4118d99217891429b)

those shaders are copied straight out of the source code for my Tetris-like rogue-like game, Astromino: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4644350/Astromino/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4644350/Astromino/)

I'm using MonoGame to make Astromino, and MonoGame's got some quirks when it comes to shaders. if you like the effect and aren't using MonoGame, I'm sure your favorite agentic AI can translate the shader to whatever specific shader language you need. (or watch the video, learn the concepts, and make your own shaders! there was some other good stuff in that video, too!)
